previousProgress: Bounded fixed-boot PID lifetime collection returned zero records and changed the next action from repeating old queries to inspecting the diagnostic log route.

sourceEvidence.observation: The manager supplies executor log-level and log-target arguments separately from application standard I/O.
IPC is initially prohibited but explicitly re-enabled after argument parsing before opening the final logging target; do not infer permanent IPC prohibition.
Standard I/O setup precedes mount namespace application; namespace failures are reported through systemd executor logging, not guaranteed application stderr.
Executor target selection accounts for the manager logging target and journal availability.
Kernel-log formatting includes a process label in message text, which is not equivalent to the trusted journal PID field.

hypothesis: An unverified executor logging route may explain why pipe capture and trusted journal PID filtering did not expose the detailed setup failure.
implementation: Design documentation only; no SSH launcher or probe implementation added.

nextProposal.scope: Read-only running-manager version, client versions, current logging target and existing protection baselines only; no additional historical journal collection.
